package rulefixtures

import (
	"fmt"
	"net/http"
	"strings"
)

// scenario for auth_or_tenant_extraction_duplicated_across_handlers: Repeated auth, tenant, or principal extraction that should live in middleware or a shared boundary helper.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: architecture; severity: info.

type OrderRepo struct{}
func (r *OrderRepo) GetOrders(tenantID, userID string) ([]string, error) { return nil, nil }
func (r *OrderRepo) GetOrder(tenantID, userID, orderID string) (string, error) { return "", nil }

func listOrdersHandler(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, repo *OrderRepo) {
	authHeader := r.Header.Get("Authorization")
	if authHeader == "" {
		http.Error(w, "missing auth token", http.StatusUnauthorized)
		return
	}
	token := strings.TrimPrefix(authHeader, "Bearer ")
	parts := strings.Split(token, ":")
	if len(parts) != 2 {
		http.Error(w, "invalid token format", http.StatusUnauthorized)
		return
	}
	tenantID := parts[0]
	userID := parts[1]

	orders, err := repo.GetOrders(tenantID, userID)
	if err != nil {
		http.Error(w, fmt.Sprintf("query error: %v", err), http.StatusInternalServerError)
		return
	}
	fmt.Fprintf(w, "orders: %v", orders)
}

func getOrderHandler(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, repo *OrderRepo) {
	authHeader := r.Header.Get("Authorization")
	if authHeader == "" {
		http.Error(w, "missing auth token", http.StatusUnauthorized)
		return
	}
	token := strings.TrimPrefix(authHeader, "Bearer ")
	parts := strings.Split(token, ":")
	if len(parts) != 2 {
		http.Error(w, "invalid token format", http.StatusUnauthorized)
		return
	}
	tenantID := parts[0]
	userID := parts[1]

	orderID := r.URL.Query().Get("id")
	order, err := repo.GetOrder(tenantID, userID, orderID)
	if err != nil {
		http.Error(w, fmt.Sprintf("query error: %v", err), http.StatusInternalServerError)
		return
	}
	fmt.Fprintf(w, "order: %s", order)
}
